SELECT b.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.plcy_nm AS plcyNm, bc.category_name AS categoryName, b.sprvsn_inst_cd_nm AS sprvsnInstCdNm, b.inq_cnt AS inqCnt
FROM benefit b JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.category_code = bc.category_code
WHERE b.is_active = 'Y' AND (b.aply_prd_se_cd IS NULL OR b.aply_prd_se_cd != '0057003') AND ( b.apply_end_date IS NULL OR b.apply_end_date >= CURDATE() )
ORDER BY b.inq_cnt DESC, b.benefit_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
